QuestInfo.name: Buying Time
QuestInfo.0: Ask #p3000001# about the status of the Protective Shield's restoration.
QuestInfo.1: Just a little longer, and the shield will be fully restored. Head south and #bdefeat all Specters on the battlefield#k.\n#rIf you fail the quest, you can forfeit it and start again.#k
QuestInfo.2: As the shield came back up, all the Specters collapsed. Victory!

1.0: We did it! We held out until the Protective Shield came back up, and it fried all of the Specters. We've won! For now, that is.
